post.content:
Before Willow Run could build a B-24 Liberator every hour, one engineer had to redesign mass production from the ground up.

Charles Emil Sorensen — Danish immigrant, Ford's head of manufacturing, and the man Henry Ford never wanted to credit — built the moving assembly line and then adapted it to win a world war.

Cast Iron Charlie is a feature documentary in development exploring the untold story behind America's Arsenal of Democracy.

#documentary #WWII #industrialhistory #WillowRun #manufacturing #history

Henry Ford got the credit.
Charles Sorensen built the system.

One bomber every hour. Willow Run. WWII's Arsenal of Democracy.

Cast Iron Charlie — documentary in development.

#WWII #industrialhistory #documentary

Cast Iron Charlie is a documentary in development about Charles Emil Sorensen — the Danish immigrant engineer who built Ford's moving assembly line and transformed American manufacturing to win World War II.

At Willow Run, he produced one B-24 Liberator bomber every hour at peak output. That achievement helped turn the tide of the war.

This is a story about systems, scale, and a man history largely forgot.

Follow for updates as we develop this project.
